name: Application control Operational Reliability: enforcement log channels are enabled and retained (T1562.002)
blast_radius: Read-only: checks that the AppLocker and Code Integrity log channels this policy depends on are enabled and not capped below 1 MB. Changes nothing.
detection: Block event (enforced) or audit event (audit mode) correlated to this test window and artifact; audit events are recorded but never counted as prevention

name: Application control Operational Reliability: application identity service runs while AppLocker enforces (T1562.001)
blast_radius: Read-only: checks that the application identity service is present and running whenever an AppLocker collection is enforced. Changes nothing.
detection: Block event (enforced) or audit event (audit mode) correlated to this test window and artifact; audit events are recorded but never counted as prevention

name: Application control Operational Reliability: allow rules open to everyone over whole drives or user-writable paths (T1562.001)
blast_radius: Read-only: reads the effective AppLocker policy and counts allow rules that apply to Everyone or Users and cover a whole drive, a user-writable location or a network path. Rule names are not recorded. Changes nothing.
detection: Block event (enforced) or audit event (audit mode) correlated to this test window and artifact; audit events are recorded but never counted as prevention
